rationale: Initializes the existing trainable logit_bias from training-shard unigram counts so the 600s run spends fewer early updates learning token marginals, while preserving the 9x512 reverse-tail recurrent architecture and export path. It also hard-disables intermediate validation, removes the unquantized pre-save validation pass, and uses a tighter final-eval reserve so more wallclock goes to actual training without touching the final int8+zlib exact evaluation.
title: Train-Shard Prior With Exact-Only Finish
